heroSubheading: STIHL chainsaws, trimmers and equipment for home and trade
aboutHtml:
Craig and Fiona Burnham run STIHL SHOP Mt Maunganui. We stock the full range of genuine STIHL outdoor power equipment - from chainsaws and trimmers to blowers, brushcutters and more. We know our equipment inside out and we know how to keep it running well for the long term.

We service and maintain STIHL equipment for homeowners and tradespeople across Mt Maunganui. Whether you're buying your first chainsaw or your hundredth, need repair or servicing, or just want straightforward advice, we're here to help. We keep spare parts in stock and we take the time to make sure you get the right equipment for the job.

Come in and see us. We're open weekdays 8am to 5pm, Saturdays 8:30am to 2:30pm, and Sundays 9am to 2pm.
